text.arabic_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive-result connector attached to the opening imperative
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah open as a consequence of what has just been shown. The command that follows is therefore not patience in the abstract; it is the required stance after the punishment sequence of 40:71-76, with the connector fused to the imperative and pulling prior threat into present instruction.

topics.headline: opening connector makes patience a consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the patience command grows out of the prior punishment scene rather than beginning a detached moral topic.
topics.reason: The prefixed connector is attached to the imperative clause and the discourse profile links the command back to the preceding punishment sequence.

words.gloss_range: direct Form I singular imperative of disciplined endurance, widened by the lack of an explicit object to cover delay, hostility, partial sight, and non-witnessing
words.root_gloss_range: restraint, patience, holding firm under pressure, with concrete bitterness as image-pressure rather than a separate local sense
words.prose: {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}) is a direct singular command, heard before the assurance that grounds it. Because it has no stated object, the command stretches across the whole pressure of the ayah: delay, opposition, partial sight, and even the possibility that the promised outcome may not be witnessed. The root field makes this restraint active and disciplined, with bitterness as image-pressure; the short, clipped command shape suits that controlled restraint. The plain Form I keeps the obligation direct, and the same patience-promise-truth refrain returns from 40:55 and echoes 30:60.

topics.headline: singular command under prior discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sudden return from the condemned group to the singular addressee, where obedience is heard before its rationale.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark a 2ms imperative resumed from the direct-address frame, and the prefixed connector ties it to the prior scene.

topics.headline: objectless endurance under partial sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that endurance is not limited to one named hardship; it covers delay, hostile pressure, and the ache of only partial visible proof.
topics.reason: The command has no explicit object, so the restraint field survives broadly, while local context narrows it to endurance under deferred or partial fulfillment.

topics.headline: plain Form I command in a repeated formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plain command belongs to a recognizable promise-truth refrain, especially with 30:60 and the earlier reprise at 40:55.
topics.reason: The local form is a direct Form I command, and the cited rows give concrete formulaic parallels at 30:60 and 40:55.

topics.headline: short sound shape suits restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clipped command form reinforces controlled restraint without adding a separate lexical sense.
topics.reason: The sound observation is modest but coherent with the short imperative and is carried only as local texture.

words.gloss_range: emphatic governing particle that binds the promise and its truth-predicate into a marked assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the reason for patience into a governed assertion. It does more than intensify the next word: it holds the promise and the truth-predicate together as one certified claim, so the command is immediately grounded before the ayah opens its two possible timelines.

topics.headline: emphasis governs the whole promise claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assurance is not a loose encouragement; the particle grammatically certifies the whole promise-truth predication.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows the particle governing the promise as its noun and the truth-word as predicate.

topics.headline: particle turns command into rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pivot from command to grounds: endurance is immediately supported by emphatic news before the alternatives open.
topics.reason: The particle follows the imperative and opens the assurance clause, changing the discourse from command to grounding assertion.

words.gloss_range: the divine promise as an accusative verbal noun in construct, locally functioning as the asserted subject of the truth claim
words.root_gloss_range: promise, pledge, threat, and appointed commitment; the local construct makes the commitment specific to God

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine name as the genitive source of the promise construct
truth-predicate evaluating the promise
later promise verb with recipients attached

words.prose: {{ar:وَعْدَ}} ({{tr:waʿda}}) is the governed subject of the assurance, a verbal noun that turns promising into a standing commitment. Its construct with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) makes the commitment specific to the divine source before {{ar:حَقٌّۭ}} ({{tr:ḥaqqun}}) evaluates it. The root can hold comfort, threat, and appointed timing; here that range is narrowed to a promise whose realization may be partly seen, deferred, or directed against them when the same root returns in {{ar:نَعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:naʿiduhum}}), with the formula also resonating with 30:60.

topics.headline: promise as governed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is presented as a standing commitment whose status can be predicated as true.
topics.reason: The word is a verbal noun governed as the accusative noun of the emphatic particle, not a finite event.

topics.headline: promise includes threat and appointed timing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same promise root consoles the messenger and threatens the deniers, with timing varied by the later branches rather than by the promise itself.
topics.reason: The root range includes pledge, threat, and appointed-time pressure, while local construct and context narrow it to divine commitment about the warned outcome.

topics.headline: construct binds promise to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certainty derives from the named promiser, not from visible probability.
topics.reason: The construct relation with the divine name is syntactically forced and makes the promise specific.

topics.headline: promise root moves from noun to verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the abstract formula becomes a concrete promise to them later in the same ayah.
topics.reason: The same root recurs as the initial promise noun and later as the addressed promise verb.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name in genitive construct position, naming the source and guarantor of the promise
words.root_gloss_range: divine name tied to worship, authority, refuge, and devotion; local syntax selects the named possessor and source of certainty

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person plural caused showing in the first branch
first-person plural promise verb with warned recipients
first-person plural taking verb in the second branch
fronted return endpoint with first-person plural suffix

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the construct and makes the promise God's own, so the assurance rests on named authority rather than on visible probabilities. The worship-authority field can sharpen why the command binds, but local grammar keeps the word as the proper divine name in genitive source position. That name then continues as the same first-person agency in {{ar:نُرِيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:nuriyannaka}}), {{ar:نَعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:naʿiduhum}}), {{ar:نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:natawaffayannaka}}), and {{ar:إِلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}), with 10:55 echoing the same promise-truth guarantor formula.

topics.headline: divine name as construct source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is anchored in named divine authority, not in prediction or probability.
topics.reason: The proper noun is the genitive complement of the promise construct, supplying both source and definiteness.

topics.headline: name carries worship-authority pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name carries authority before which patience becomes obligation, while the local syntax keeps the selected role as possessor/source.
topics.reason: The derivational and devotion field may color the divine-name authority, but local grammar selects the proper name in construct rather than an independent derivation claim.

topics.headline: named God becomes repeated We-speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the later showing, promising, taking, and return-to-Us are not separate agencies but the same divine actor named here.
topics.reason: The divine name is followed by repeated first-person plural forms and the endpoint pronoun, preserving one agency through all alternatives.

topics.headline: formulaic named guarantor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise-truth formula belongs to a broader pattern, with 10:55 grounding certainty in divine ownership and 40:77 applying it to deferred judgment.
topics.reason: The cited CRITICAL rows give the concrete formula parallel at 10:55.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative predicate assigning established truth and rightful due to the divine promise
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, right, due claim, and binding settlement; local predication makes the promise established and owed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector plus conditional-disjunctive opener after the truth predicate

words.prose: {{ar:حَقٌّۭ}} ({{tr:ḥaqqun}}) is the predicate that seals the rationale: the promise bears the quality of established truth, and its tanwīn gives the assurance a local closure after the prior punishment scene. Its root field adds due-claim and rightful settlement pressure, so later taking and return sound like enactments of what is owed, not unrelated events. Because this predicate comes before {{ar:فَإِمَّا}} ({{tr:fa-immā}}), the two branches can vary what is witnessed without reopening whether the promise is true; 30:60 gives the same formulaic warning against being unsettled.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate of established truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth is assigned as the promise's established quality, not counted as one item among many.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the predicate of the emphatic clause, and its indefinite form gives qualitative force.

topics.headline: truth joins due claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is not only accurate; it carries the force of a rightful settlement that later taking and return will enact.
topics.reason: The root field of right, due, and liability is valid pressure, while local predication selects established truth of the promise.

topics.headline: predicate seals certainty before alternatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alternatives affect witness timing only after the promise has already been sealed as true.
topics.reason: The predicate closes the assurance before the conditional-disjunctive frame opens.

topics.headline: sealed cadence after punishment scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local closure before branching, with the prior punishment scene giving weight to the truth claim.
topics.reason: The tanwin and verse position create a modest closure effect, and the discourse context supplies the punishment background.

words.gloss_range: connector moving from settled promise-truth into the conditional-disjunctive scenarios

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conditional-disjunctive particle opening the first branch

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) pivots from the sealed truth claim into possible scenarios. Because it is fused to {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:immā}}), the coming alternatives stay grammatically dependent on the certainty just stated: they explain modes and timing of disclosure, not the reliability of the promise.

topics.headline: connector pivots from truth to scenarios
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alternatives remain dependent on the promise-truth clause, so chronology changes without weakening certainty.
topics.reason: The connector is prefixed to the branch opener and links the settled assertion to the conditional-disjunctive frame.

words.gloss_range: conditional-disjunctive opener whose first branch awaits completion by the second alternative

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second branch conjunction completing the disjunction

words.prose: {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:immā}}) opens a branch that cannot stand alone; the reader must wait for {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) and then for the shared answer. That architecture localizes uncertainty to whether the messenger is shown some promised outcome or taken first, while the final return remains outside the uncertainty.

topics.headline: first branch awaits second and shared answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that uncertainty is carefully localized to the messenger's horizon while the shared outcome remains fixed.
topics.reason: The particle opens a conditional-disjunctive branch completed by the later alternative and both branches share the same apodosis.

words.gloss_range: Form IV caused perception with emphatic ending and singular object suffix, locally governing a partial promised object
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, judging, and being made aware; local Form IV selects caused disclosure rather than autonomous sight

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: partial object governed by the showing verb
paired emphatic taking verb in the second branch

words.prose: {{ar:نُرِيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:nuriyannaka}}) makes the first branch a divinely caused, personal disclosure: the addressee is made to see, and the heavy ending secures the branch if it occurs. The seeing root can reach perception and recognition, but local grammar narrows that pressure to selective evidentiary disclosure of {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}), not autonomous sight. The verb belongs to a recurring messengerly pattern where some promised outcome may be shown or withheld; 17:1 similarly uses selected showing, while 40:13 addresses a wider audience. Its matching form with {{ar:نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:natawaffayannaka}}) balances sight and taking as two governed futures.

topics.headline: caused showing made personal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disclosure is divinely caused and personally directed to the singular addressee, not self-produced sight or impersonal publicity.
topics.reason: The Form IV verb carries first-person plural agency, an emphatic ending, and a second-person object suffix.

topics.headline: seeing becomes evidentiary disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised part may function as evidence or recognition, not mere eyesight, while local grammar keeps it a caused showing event.
topics.reason: The root range includes seeing and knowing, but the local Form IV verb with object {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}) narrows it to caused disclosure of partial content.

topics.headline: selective showing in messenger formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that being shown only some fulfillment is a recognized messengerly branch, with selected-sign showing in 17:1 and audience showing contrasted at 40:13.
topics.reason: The cited parallels make the showing curated and horizon-bound, not an exhaustive promise of visible vindication.

topics.headline: parallel emphatic branch verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that showing and taking are balanced as two divinely governed futures through matching morphology.
topics.reason: The two branch verbs share divine subject force, emphatic ending, and the second-person suffix.

words.gloss_range: a direct-object noun of portion, defining what may be shown as only part of the promised matter
words.root_gloss_range: part, portion, segmentation, and division; local syntax makes the portion belong to the promised content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative pronoun defining the promised content selected by the part noun

words.prose: {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}) is the object of showing, so the first branch explicitly offers only a portion. Its dependency on {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) keeps that portion tied to the content promised to them, not to the messenger himself. The part-word implies a larger unshown whole, with segmentation pressure sharpening the point: visible proof may arrive as a fragment while the promise remains larger. The same partial-promise architecture is visible at 13:40.

topics.headline: shown content is explicitly partial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visible disclosure is only a portion, so prophetic witness cannot be equated with total fulfillment.
topics.reason: The word is the accusative object of the showing verb and names a part against an implied whole.

topics.headline: part defined by relative promise clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the portion is part of what is promised to them, not part of the messenger or of his capacity to see.
topics.reason: The construct-like dependency with the relative pronoun makes the following promise clause define the portion.

topics.headline: segmented disclosure leaves remainder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a shown fragment points to a larger unshown whole, which is why patience is required.
topics.reason: Segmentation derivatives add valid pressure, while the local noun remains the portion selected from the promised content.

topics.headline: parallel partial-promise formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 13:40 uses the same partial-promise frame, separating messengerly sight from complete divine accounting.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the concrete parallel at 13:40.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun that packages the promised event-clause as definable content after the portion noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: promise verb completing the relative clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) keeps the object phrase open until the promise verb arrives. It binds the portion to {{ar:نَعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:naʿiduhum}}), turning a future promised event into definable content from which only some may be shown.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the portion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the part being shown is grammatically defined by the promise clause that follows.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the relative clause as modifying the portion noun.

topics.headline: future event compressed into object phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording turns a future promised event into selectable content, allowing only some of it to be shown.
topics.reason: The fixed relative form looks forward to the promise verb and packages that clause inside the object phrase.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect promise/threat verb with a bound third-person plural object suffix, defining the recipients of the promised consequence
words.root_gloss_range: promise, pledge, threat, and appointed commitment; local form is promising or threatening them, not counting them

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: initial promise noun in the assurance clause
portion noun that subordinates the promise clause to partial showing

words.prose: {{ar:نَعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:naʿiduhum}}) completes the relative clause and fixes the promised consequence on them through the bound plural object suffix. The corrected root keeps the verb in the promise/threat field, not a counting field, so the same root that comforted the messenger in {{ar:وَعْدَ}} ({{tr:waʿda}}) now targets the deniers. Because the verb sits under {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}), what may be shown is only part of what is promised to them; 13:40 preserves the same messengerly pattern.

topics.headline: object suffix fixes recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warned group, not the messenger, are the recipients of the promised consequence.
topics.reason: The bound third-person plural suffix is the direct object and resumes the hostile deniers.

topics.headline: corrected root makes threat operative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is promising or threatening them, not enumerating them, and its range makes consolation and warning meet.
topics.reason: The bundle corrects the root to promise/threat, and the local object suffix makes the warning recipients explicit.

topics.headline: promise verb completes relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that partial showing is subordinated to the promise-to-them clause, so the visible part does not limit the real promise.
topics.reason: The verb closes the relative clause under the portion noun.

topics.headline: abstract promise becomes addressed consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the initial promise-truth formula becoming an operative verb directed at them, with 13:40 showing the recurring frame.
topics.reason: The same root recurs from the initial verbal noun to this finite promise verb, with the concrete parallel at 13:40.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive conjunction completing the two-branch frame between showing and taking

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conditional-disjunctive opener completed by the second branch

words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) supplies the second branch required by {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:immā}}). Its short interruption between two long emphatic verbs prevents the showing and the taking from collapsing into sequence: they are alternative messengerly horizons, while the later return clause remains shared.

topics.headline: second alternative without branch collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that being shown and being taken are real alternatives, not a sequence, while both remain under one return outcome.
topics.reason: The particle completes the disjunctive frame and separates two emphatic verbs before their shared apodosis.

words.gloss_range: Form V emphatic imperfect with singular object suffix, making the second branch a complete divine taking of the addressee
words.root_gloss_range: fulfillment, completion, full taking, receipt, and settlement; local Form V selects completed taking rather than mere interruption

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired emphatic showing verb in the first branch
shared apodosis and return endpoint after both alternatives

words.prose: {{ar:نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:natawaffayannaka}}) is the second emphatic branch, with the same singular object suffix as {{ar:نُرِيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:nuriyannaka}}). The root's completion and full-taking field makes this possible death a completed term under divine control, not a failed promise or an unfinished interruption. Structurally, the branch still leads to the same {{ar:فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ}} ({{tr:fa-ilaynā yurjaʿūn}}) endpoint, so the messenger's being taken changes witness, not destination or fulfillment; 3:55 adds a concrete completion-taking comparison.

topics.headline: same addressee in second emphatic branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same singular addressee is held across both branches, while the action shifts from being shown to being taken.
topics.reason: The verb carries first-person plural agency, emphatic ending, and the second-person object suffix that matches the first branch.

topics.headline: completion root makes death a fulfilled term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taking branch is framed as completed reception or settlement, not an unfinished interruption of the promise.
topics.reason: The completion field survives as lexical pressure, while local Form V selects divine taking of the addressee.

topics.headline: taking cannot suspend recipients' return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger's possible taking changes witness, not the destination or fulfillment for the warned group.
topics.reason: The second branch shares the final apodosis with the first branch.

topics.headline: recognized messengerly taking formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taking branch belongs to a recognized formula, with 3:55 adding completion-taking background.
topics.reason: The cited CRITICAL rows provide the concrete 3:55 comparison and the recurring show-or-take pattern.

topics.headline: completion answers due truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completion language resonates with the earlier truth-as-due claim, so even the messenger's death sits inside divine settlement.
topics.reason: The completion field coheres with the earlier truth and promise fields without replacing the local taking sense.

words.gloss_range: apodosis marker attached to the fronted endpoint, turning both alternatives toward one consequence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted endpoint after the apodosis marker

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the answer to both alternatives. It does not add a third event; attached to {{ar:إِلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}), it funnels partial showing and completed taking into one resolution where the endpoint is heard before the return action.

topics.headline: final connector funnels both branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two alternatives are resolved by one answer, with the endpoint arriving immediately after the apodosis marker.
topics.reason: The connector before the fronted endpoint marks the response to the whole conditional-disjunctive frame.

words.gloss_range: fronted prepositional endpoint toward Us, combining direction with divine jurisdiction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person plural suffix in the fronted endpoint

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) is fronted before the return verb, so the clause answers the destination before it answers the mechanics of return. The phrase carries movement toward Us and, in this accounting frame, referral to divine jurisdiction. Its {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) suffix also answers the earlier divine We-actions, keeping showing, promising, taking, and return under one speaker even if voice variation changes the route of return; 96:8 gives a concrete return-to-Lord parallel, while this ayah places the endpoint first.

topics.headline: destination fronted before return mechanics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is fixed first: return is to Us before agency or mechanics are considered.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is the fronted complement of the return verb and restricts the endpoint.

topics.headline: movement becomes referral to authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is not only spatial direction but jurisdiction for accounting.
topics.reason: The preposition with the return verb supports direction, and the divine endpoint plus accounting context license jurisdictional pressure.

topics.headline: endpoint answers repeated We-actions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same divine speaker who shows, promises, and takes also receives the final return, even where voice variation shifts route.
topics.reason: The first-person plural suffix answers earlier first-person plural verbs and remains stable across passive-active qiraat variation.

topics.headline: return-to-Lord parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 96:8 names return to your Lord, while this ayah front-loads the endpoint to govern the whole branch frame.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row gives the concrete return endpoint comparison at 96:8.

words.gloss_range: passive imperfect plural return, with qiraat variation around agency while the destination remains fixed
words.root_gloss_range: return, reversal, restoration, referral, and final resort; local passive with fronted endpoint makes it accounting movement to divine authority

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted destination governing the return verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُرْجَعُونَ}} ({{tr:yurjaʿūn}}) closes the ayah after the endpoint has already been heard, making motion subordinate to destination. The canonical passive makes the warned group undergo return while the agent is unspoken; accepted active readings vary agency and address, but {{ar:إِلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) keeps the endpoint unchanged. The root field can include resort, recovery, and referral, and here that pressure is narrowed to accounting movement back to divine authority. The final return enacts the earlier promise-truth logic, with 40:43 shifting return from confession to decree and 96:8 giving a concrete return endpoint parallel.

topics.headline: passive return suppresses agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warned group as the ones undergoing return, with the returning agent left unspoken and the destination explicit.
topics.reason: The canonical form is passive 3mp with a fronted endpoint complement.

topics.headline: voice variation shifts agency not endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that passive and active readings vary how the return is voiced, while {{ar:إِلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ilaynā}}) keeps the destination fixed.
topics.reason: Accepted reading variation can clarify agency contrast, but it does not replace the canonical passive local surface.

topics.headline: return becomes final resort and accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that return is more than reversal of motion; with the fronted endpoint it becomes referral to the ultimate authority.
topics.reason: Root derivatives for recovery, resort, and referral add valid pressure, while local grammar selects return to the divine endpoint.

topics.headline: motion subordinated to destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends with the motion verb only after the destination has already been fixed.
topics.reason: The return verb follows the fronted endpoint at the end of the ayah.

topics.headline: return enacts promise-truth logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final return executes the promise and due-truth logic announced earlier, extending the prior punishment-accounting sequence.
topics.reason: The final verb completes the movement from promise assertion to enacted return.

topics.headline: parallel return endpoint formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final accountability endpoint belongs to a wider return pattern, shifting from confession in 40:43 to decree here and echoing nominal return in 96:8.
topics.reason: The cited rows provide concrete references at 40:43 and 96:8, plus the messengerly non-witnessing pattern.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative فاصبر is governed by the assertion إن وعد الله حق.
baseline_models.mechanism: Restraint of panic is rational because the promise is presented as both reality-matching and binding; delay therefore tests composure rather than the promise.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from panic supplies the operative discipline commanded during delay.
A spoken promise opens expectation and gives patience a future object.
Binding necessity makes the promised outcome obligatory rather than merely plausible.

changed_reading.before: Be patient because the promise is reassuringly true.
changed_reading.after: Hold panic in check because delay occurs inside a binding commitment and does not count against it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The alternatives نرينك بعض and نتوفينك alter the addressee's access, while فإلينا يرجعون remains outside that alternative.
baseline_models.mechanism: Partial showing and taking the addressee are mutually exclusive routes for the witness, but the opponents' return is invariant; the uncertainty concerns observation, not fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to appear marks one possible route by which fulfillment enters the addressee's experience.
Partitioning limits what may be displayed without partitioning the promise's validity.
Taking the soul supplies the alternate endpoint of the addressee's earthly witnessing.
Return supplies the common terminus that survives both alternatives.

changed_reading.before: The promised event may occur in the addressee's lifetime or may fail to do so.
changed_reading.after: Only the addressee's sight of a portion is contingent; the opponents' return and reckoning are not.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وعد first names God's promise as the ground of patience and then names what is promised to them.
baseline_models.mechanism: One root carries participant-relative valence: it opens hope for the patient addressee while functioning as warning toward the plural objects; حق secures both faces.

activation_trace.role: Promise as expectation supplies reassurance to the commanded addressee.
Threatening promise supplies the adverse content directed toward them.
Reality-matching stability prevents either participant-relative face from becoming empty rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: God's promise is a generic assurance.
changed_reading.after: The same promise is hope from the addressee's side and threat from the opponents' side, with truth binding the two.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact command-promise-truth sequence at 40:55 and 40:77 turns patience into a repeated practice; the earlier attachment of evening and morning praise gives that practice a recurring temporal cadence.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint anchors the focus command that the earlier verse repeats.
The same restraint command establishes a deliberate reprise rather than a one-time exhortation.
The repeated promise keeps future expectation attached to both patience commands.
Repeated binding truth stabilizes the refrain across the intervening dispute.
Evening supplies one temporal pole for renewing the patient stance.
Morning supplies the complementary pole, making endurance recurrent rather than inert.

structural_cues: 40:55 and 40:77 repeat فاصبر إن وعد الله حق verbatim before giving different continuations.
The first occurrence attaches evening and morning praise; the second follows the extended judgment scene at 40:69-76.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact refrain and the two daily poles; I infer that recurrence turns patience into maintained discipline across delay. The live alternative is that evening and morning remain local instructions at 40:55 and do not color 40:77.

changed_reading.before: Patience is a single response to deferred fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: Patience is a repeatedly renewed holding practice that spans the interval in which the binding promise remains only partly visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 40:28 the same phrase بعض الذي يعدكم is the portion that strikes the deniers if the messenger is truthful; at 40:77 that portion may be shown to the messenger. One promised event is thus impact from their side and evidence from his side.

activation_trace.role: Divine showing supplies the messenger-facing side of the promised portion.
A partitioned portion is the shared lexical hinge between the two perspectives.
Truth realized in action links the messenger's truthfulness to fulfillment of his warning.
Hitting the intended target makes the promised portion an event that lands on its addressees.
The earlier partitioned portion establishes the near-verbatim mirror.
The warning-directed promise identifies what strikes the resistant audience.

structural_cues: 40:28 has يصبكم بعض الذي يعدكم; 40:77 has نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم.
The pronouns reverse the same portion from what reaches them to what may be shown to the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the near-verbatim phrases, the pronoun reversal, and the target-hitting branch; I infer that they present two participant views of one class of fulfillment. They could instead be independent uses of a common warning formula.

changed_reading.before: Some promised punishment may simply become visible to the messenger.
changed_reading.after: The promised portion has two coordinated faces: it lands on the deniers and, contingently, becomes validating evidence for the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, opponents try to make truth lose its footing, while God judges by truth and the arriving command is decided by truth. حق in the focus therefore carries enforceability and public settlement, not only propositional correctness.

activation_trace.role: Binding necessity anchors the promise as an enforceable obligation.
The attempted collapse of an argument supplies the opposition's effort to dislodge truth.
Truth made manifest remains the object that false dispute unsuccessfully tries to remove.
The paired judging and non-judging clauses make decisive judgment the practical difference of divine truth.
Truth is shown through judgment rather than left as an unexecuted assertion.
When the command arrives, decisive judgment supplies the promised transition from delay to settlement.
Manifested truth is the medium of the decision immediately after the focus.

structural_cues: 40:5 stages an attempt to dislodge الحق; 40:20 makes divine judgment occur بالحق.
Immediately after the focus, 40:78 joins arrival of God's command, judgment بالحق, and loss of the falsifiers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated truth/judgment constructions and the attempted dislodging of truth; I infer that the nominal predicate حق in 40:77 absorbs this operative force. It may more narrowly assert only the promise's truthfulness.

changed_reading.after: The promise is a reality-bound verdict that will be executed and publicly distinguish truth from attempted nullification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate contrast between messengers narrated and not narrated, followed by signs being shown, activates both visual showing and the split mapped branch of transmitting a report. Some fulfillment may be disclosed through selected narrative and sign, not only through direct spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Direct causing-to-see anchors the ordinary display reading.
The split branch of transmitting report supplies an exploratory mediated mode of showing.
Partitioning makes selection, rather than total disclosure, central to the mechanism.
Narrating a sequential report distinguishes disclosed messenger histories from undisclosed ones.
Permission limits when a sign can be produced and blocks treating visibility as messenger-controlled.
The repeated causative showing extends the focus verb into an explicit display of signs.
Visible marks give the selected disclosure an evidentiary form.

structural_cues: 40:78 immediately contrasts قصصنا and لم نقصص before denying messenger control over signs.
40:81 repeats the causative showing construction and makes signs its object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the narrated/un-narrated selection, permission boundary, repeated showing, and a non-dominant report branch for ر ء ي; I infer a mediated disclosure channel. The live alternative is that نرينك in 40:77 remains strictly direct witnessing and the narrative contrast only analogizes selection.

changed_reading.before: Showing some means letting the addressee directly watch a portion happen.
changed_reading.after: Showing some can include a curated disclosure through event, sign, or transmitted history, while the undisclosed remainder remains fully promised.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, visibility progresses from signs actively shown, to traces that can be inspected, to overpowering force finally seen. The last sight no longer benefits belief, so patience belongs before coercive visibility rather than to a lack of available evidence.

activation_trace.role: Sight in the focus anchors the question of what kind and timing of visibility matters.
Signs actively made visible supply the first, non-coercive grade of evidence.
Manifest signs identify what is already available to recognition.
Directed visual or reflective inspection supplies an inferential mode of seeing past outcomes.
Remaining marks make prior fulfillment legible without reproducing the event.
Direct sight supplies the terminal grade in which the threatened outcome is undeniable.
Overpowering force identifies what terminal sight finally encounters.
The explicit loss of benefit marks terminal seeing as too late for responsive trust.

structural_cues: 40:81-85 orders shown signs, inspection of prior consequences, direct sight of force, and the non-benefit of belief at that point.
The focus distinguishes the messenger possibly being shown some from the opponents certainly being returned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered visibility sequence and the explicit failure of benefit after final sight; I infer an epistemic gradient from invitational evidence to coercive disclosure. The sequence could instead be a looser catalog of signs and consequences.

changed_reading.before: Patience lasts until enough of the promise becomes visible.
changed_reading.after: Patience trusts through non-coercive signs and traces; waiting for the final, overpowering sight is precisely what leaves no useful response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah joins worldly support with the day witnesses stand, names a common return to God, and places death before a named term within the human sequence. Death can end one observer's historical horizon without ending the promise's adjudicative horizon.

activation_trace.role: Taking the soul marks the possible closure of the addressee's earthly horizon.
Return establishes the larger horizon that remains after personal death.
The common return to God broadens the focus return beyond an isolated threat.
Support and making prevail supply the promise's worldly horizon.
Witnesses standing supply the later public horizon paired with worldly support.
Some being taken before the later human stage makes early death part of the stated temporal order.
A fixed terminal period supplies the bounded personal clock.
Completion and conclusion when the command arrives supply the promise's clock beyond any one witness.

structural_cues: 40:51 coordinates support in worldly life with the day witnesses stand.
40:67 allows taking before a named term; 40:78 places final decision at arrival of God's command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two victory horizons, bounded human life, and later decision; I infer that the focus alternatives relocate the witness between horizons rather than weaken fulfillment. A narrower reading could leave the two horizons uncoordinated.

changed_reading.before: The addressee's death is the unfulfilled alternative to seeing vindication.
changed_reading.after: Death closes only the addressee's historical sightline; worldly manifestation and final public judgment remain coordinated modes of completion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping for و ع د, not the ordinary promise branch. It remains anchored in the two focus occurrences of وعد and in بعض, and the surah supplies account and fixed-term cues. Render it only as a measured or prepared resonance, never as an etymological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of وعد stand beside بعض and the alternative endpoint نتوفينك.

activation_trace.role: Counting the enumerated supplies an exploratory image of fulfillment apportioned into knowable and unseen portions.
Prepared provision supplies an exploratory sense that deferred fulfillment is readied rather than improvised.
The explicit part makes the counted-installment analogy visibly focus-anchored.
Account and enumeration supply a surah-level environment for the measured resonance.
A fixed term supplies the temporal boundary within which the viewer may or may not receive an installment.

changed_reading.before: Some is an indefinite reduction of what may be seen.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, some behaves like a counted installment of an already prepared schedule, while death marks the viewer's allotted boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses from bodily return to the رجع branch of returning speech, so it is not a claim that يرجعون grammatically means they answer. It remains anchored in يرجعون and the promised-to-them object, while 40:83 makes mocked content encircle the mockers. Downstream prose should present it as rhetorical resonance: denial comes back as embodied reply.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فإلينا يرجعون closes a sentence about what is promised to them.

activation_trace.role: Returned answer or speech supplies the cross-domain image of the denied promise coming back as reply.
The warning-directed promise identifies the content that denial tries to leave unanswered.
Descending and surrounding harm turns the mocked object into an enclosing consequence.
Mockery supplies the prior speech-act to which the realized consequence functions as an answer.

changed_reading.before: They are physically returned for judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their return also stages a returned answer: what they mocked comes back around them as realized reply.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The stopper image is materially distant from the imperative's ordinary self-restraint sense. It remains packet-anchored in the صبر inventory and gains a pressure analogue from hearts at throats with an outlet held shut. Render it only as an embodied analogy for maintained composure, not as a lexical translation of فاصبر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative فاصبر initiates the focus while fulfillment remains deferred.

activation_trace.role: A stopper sealing a vessel supplies the exploratory material image of composure retaining pressure.
Tight, well-made structure supplies the stable form that allows the pressure to be held without collapse.
Closing an outlet after filling supplies the contextual pressure-and-containment analogue.

changed_reading.before: Patience is inward endurance during delay.
changed_reading.after: As an embodied outlier, patience is maintaining a sound seal under mounting pressure until the promised resolution arrives.

strongest_changes: The 40:28 mirror makes the same promised portion an impact on deniers and possible evidence shown to the messenger.
The recurring حق-judgment sequence turns the true promise into an executable public settlement.
The 40:78-85 sequence recasts partial showing as curated disclosure and distinguishes useful signs from terminal sight that comes too late.
The repeated 40:55 refrain makes patience a renewed discipline across both worldly and final horizons.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a precise network around the focus: a verbatim patience refrain, an earlier near-quotation with reversed pronouns, and an immediate after-sequence about selected narration, permission, signs, traces, and belated sight. Split mappings also kept mediated narration and counted preparation available without replacing the dominant readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The narrative branch of the split ر ء ي mapping may describe only an analogy to selected disclosure rather than a live mode of نرينك.
The dual hope-threat valence of وعد is participant-relative, but the packet does not force every promised content into that polarity.
The counted-installment, returned-answer, and pressure-seal readings remain material or rhetorical resonances and should not be presented as lexical conclusions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Promise remains fixed across visibility and the observer’s death.** `ص ب ر/B001` restrains panic, `و ع د/B001` opens expectation, `و ف ي/B001` supplies completion, and `ر ج ع/B001` return. The alternatives detach fulfillment from the messenger’s witnessing. I infer that truth does not depend on being seen within one lifespan; patience reads as release from observational control.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The told/untold messenger history in 40:78 broadens patience beyond one lifetime and one biography: fulfillment belongs to a much longer dispatch sequence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Fulfillment is independent of the observer's remaining lifespan.** Lexically, `و ف ي:B002` is "receiving the soul in full as death or sleep," `و ع د:B001` a promise opening expectation, and `ر ج ع:B001` return or sending back. Structurally, patience and true promise are followed by two alternatives: some consequence may be shown, or the addressee may be taken in full; both terminate in the opponents' return. Full taking limits what the human witness sees but not what the promise executes. The packet gives the alternatives and common endpoint; I infer that fulfillment does not depend on one observer's temporal access. Patience therefore rests on returned jurisdiction, not on guaranteed immediate spectacle.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:78 immediately broadens the unseen horizon with untold messengers, reinforcing that fulfillment and dispatch exceed what one observer is shown or told.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı, kişinin sarsıntı ve yakınma karşısında kendini tutması, aklın ve doğru sayılan davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kalması olarak kurar. Bu yüzden ruhsal dayanma ile zorla alıkoyma, öldürme, güvence verme ve somut nesne adları birbirinden ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal içsel özdenetim ve dayanıklılıkla sınırlıdır; dışarıdan zorla tutma ya da özel kalıp anlamları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca genel özdenetim ve dayanma çekirdeğini verir, kalıba bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Sarsıntı, sıkıntı ya da istenmeyen bir durum karşısında kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyması ve doğru bildiği tutumu kararlılıkla sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Kişi, sarsıntı ve yakınma dürtüsüne karşı kendini tutar.
Bu kendini tutma, aklın ve doğru davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kararlı kalmayı içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı sarsıntının karşıtı olan, kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyup gereken tutumda kalmasını sağlayan bir özdenetim olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tepkiyi denetleyip doğru görülen tutumu sürdürme çekirdeğinin tamamı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kendini tutmayı hem de güçlük karşısında kararlı kalmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntı veya yıkım karşısında taşkın tepki vermeden dirençli kalmayı anlatan bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Güçlük karşısında sağlam ve denetimli kalma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Aklın ya da doğru davranışın gerektirdiği her durumda kendini tutma kapsamını daraltır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ortak çekirdeği dışarıdan uygulanan zorlama ve alıkoyma olarak verir; bunun ölüm gerçekleşene kadar tutma ve yönetici önünde ant içmeye zorlama biçimleri vardır. Bu çerçeve içsel dayanma anlamından ve ödeşme cezasının bağımsız hukuki amacından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal zorlayıcı alıkoymayı, öldürülmek üzere tutmayı ve yönetici önünde ant içmeye zorlamayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; genel zorla tutma ile öldürme ve ant içirme kalıpları ayrı yüzlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlıyı kaçamayacağı biçimde zorla tutmak; özel kullanımlarda onu öldürülene kadar bağlı bırakmak ya da yetkili önünde ant içmeye zorlamaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da canlı dışarıdan uygulanan güçle alıkonur ve çıkışı engellenir.
Öldürme kullanımında canlı, ölüm gerçekleşene kadar bağlı ya da tutulmuş durumda bırakılır.
Ant içme kullanımında kişi, yetkili makam önünde ağır bir ant vermeye zorlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zorla alıkoyma çekirdeğini, öldürülmek üzere tutulan canlıyı ve yetkili önünde ant içmeye mecbur bırakılan kişiyi kapsayacak biçimde sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel zorlama çekirdeği ile ölüm ve ant bağlamındaki özel gerçekleşmeleri birlikte temsil eder.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın ya da başka bir canlının ölüm gerçekleşene kadar kaçamayacağı biçimde tutulduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Ant içmeye zorlama kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana anlamı bir başkası için maddi yükü üstlenen güvence verici kişidir. Topluluğun işlerinde onunla birlikte bulunan kişi kullanımı bununla ilişkili olsa da aynı hukuki yükümlülüğü zorunlu olarak taşımaz; bu nedenle ana anlamdan bağımlı bir uzantı olarak ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Güvence verip yük üstlenme çekirdektir; topluluğun işlerine eşlik eden kişi bununla eşitlenmeyen ilişkili bir kullanımdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasının yükümlülüğünü yerine getireceğine güvence vererek doğabilecek yükü üstlenen kişidir. Topluluğun işlerinde onun yanında duran kişi için de ilişkili biçimde kullanılır.

facets.statement: Kişi, bir başkasının yükümlülüğü için güvence verir ve doğabilecek maddi yükü üstlenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir başkasının borç ya da yükümlülüğünü üstlenme çekirdeği için kullanılır; eşlik eden kişi uzantısını tek başına karşılamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin üst bölümü ya da yan sınırıdır; kap ve mezarın çevre yanlarını da belirtir. Kalıba bağlı kullanımda bir kabın bu sınıra kadar dolmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün üstteki bölümü veya yan sınırı belirtilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sert taş, kaya yüzeyi ve taşlı arazi gibi somut varlıkları belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çıkışı bulunmayan ağır sıkıntı veya savaş durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal sınırlı bir geleneksel adlandırmada birbirine yaklaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın göndergesi fiziksel taş ya da arazidir; komşu dal aynı adlandırma çevresinden gelişmiş olsa da soyut ve tehlikeli bir durumu bildirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; somut taşlık alan ile aynı adlandırma çevresindeki ağır sıkıntı anlamı arasındaki sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبرة والصبارة من الحجارة الشديدة الغليظة، والصبر الأرض ذات الحصباء، وأم صبار للحرة أو الصفاة الغليظة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس أعلى الشيء وجانبه، ولا الداهية إلا من جهة المثل في أم صبار وأم صبور.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصبرة من الحجارة ما اشتد وغلظ (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib)؛ الصبارة الحجارة (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الصبر الأرض التي فيها حصباء (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ أم صبار الحرة أو الصفاة (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi savaş, ağır yıkım ve çıkış yolu bulunmayan büyük iş gibi durumları belirli adlandırmalarla anlatır. Çekirdek yalnızca zorluk değil, içine düşülen durumun ağır ve kaçışsız oluşudur; somut kaya veya arazi göndergesi bu dala alınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli adlandırmalara bağlı ağır ve çıkışsız durumu kapsar; somut taşlık yer ile yalnızca soğuk şiddeti kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak olmayan daldır; tanım yalnızca kaynakta verilen sabit adlandırmaların savaş, yıkım ve çıkışsız ağır durum değerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Belirli adlandırmalarda, bir topluluğun içine düştüğü savaş, büyük yıkım ya da çıkış yolu bulunmayan ağır durumdur.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da topluluk ağır ve büyük bir durumun içine düşer.
Durum savaş veya büyük yıkım biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.
Bu durumdan çıkış sağlayacak bir yol bulunmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli adlandırmaları savaş, büyük yıkım veya kaçış yolu olmayan ağır bir iş olarak açıklar ve duruma düşme ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Savaş veya büyük yıkım dahil, belirli adlandırmalarla kurulan ağır ve kaçışsız durumların tümü için geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Durumun ağırlığını ve ondan çıkış bulunmamasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun savaş veya benzeri ağır bir olayla kuşatıldığı anlatımlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağır bir duruma düşme ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Her örnekte açıkça çıkış bulunmaması koşulunu söylemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal savaş ya da yıkım gibi genel ve çıkışsız bir ağır durumu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca kışın çok sert soğuğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanı zorlayan yoğun bir şiddet niteliği taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın alanı belirli adlandırmalarla kurulan genel ve kaçışsız tehlikedir; komşu dal ise mevsime bağlı tek bir fiziksel şiddet türüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; genel çıkışsız ağır durum ile kışa özgü sert soğuk arasındaki karşılaştırma en belirgin sınırı sağlar.
branches.branch_image_ar: الوقوع في شدة لا منفذ منها
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أم صبار وأم صبور للداهية، والحرب، والأمر العظيم أو الشديد الذي لا منفذ منه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأرض أو الحجر إذا أريد بهما المعنى الحسي، ولا صبارة الشتاء الخاصة بالبرد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وقع القوم في أم صبور إذا وقعوا في أمر عظيم (maqayis)؛ أم صبار الحرب والداهية الشديدة (ayn)؛ وقع القوم في أم صبور أي في أمر شديد (sihah)؛ أم صبور أمر لا منفذ له عنه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan kış mevsiminin çok sert soğuğunu ve bu soğuk sırasında gelme örneğini verir. Anlam genel bir yıkım veya ruhsal dayanma değildir; mevsim ve sıcaklık niteliğiyle sınırlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kışın şiddetli soğuğunu belirtir; genel sıkıntı, dayanma ve taş adları bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım kaynakta verilen kış soğuğu anlamını korur ve başka kalıp anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Kış mevsiminde yaşanan çok sert ve yoğun soğuktur.

facets.statement: Soğuk olağan düzeyi aşan güçlü bir şiddet taşır.
Bu şiddet özellikle kış mevsimine bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ifadeyi kışın şiddetli soğuğu olarak açıklar ve bu zaman dilimi içinde gerçekleşen bir geliş örneğiyle destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kışa özgü, keskin ve şiddetli soğuğu kısa ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kış mevsimini ve sert soğuk niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olayın kışın yoğun soğuk döneminde gerçekleştiğini belirten zaman bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mevsim ile şiddetli soğuğu eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kış mevsimindeki fiziksel soğuğun şiddetini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal savaş veya yıkım gibi çıkışsız ağır durumları belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanı zorlayan yoğun bir şiddeti anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mevsim ve sıcaklıkla sınırlıdır; komşu dal ise fiziksel soğuk gerektirmeyen, kaçışsız bir tehlike ya da sıkıntı durumudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; kışa bağlı fiziksel şiddet ile genel çıkışsız sıkıntı arasındaki ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه صبارة الشتاء وصنابر الشتاء بمعنى شدة برده.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الداهية العامة، ولا صبر النفس، ولا أسماء الحجارة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: صبارة الشتاء شدة برده (sihah)؛ أتيته في صبارة الشتاء أي في شدة البرد (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir ağacın sıkılıp yoğunlaştırılmış özünü ve bunun acı bir ilaç olarak kullanımını verir. Bu gönderge ekşi bir ağaç meyvesinden ve ruhsal dayanma anlamından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ağacın acı özsuyu ile bundan yapılan ilacı kapsar; ekşi meyve ve ruhsal dayanma anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca bitkiden elde edilen acı öz ve ilaç anlamını taşır.

concept_map.definition: Bir ağaçtan çıkarılan yoğun ve acı özsudur; ilaç olarak da kullanılır.

facets.statement: Madde bir ağacın çıkarılmış ve yoğunlaştırılmış özsuyudur.
Tadı acıdır ve ilaç olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar göndergeyi bir ağacın acı özsuyu ve bu özden oluşan ilaç olarak tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bitkiden çıkarılan acı öz ile bunun ilaç niteliğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaç kökenini, öz maddeyi ve acı niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Maddenin bitkisel kökeninden çok ilaç olarak kullanımının öne çıktığı bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Acı tat ile ilaç kullanımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Maddenin özellikle ağaçtan çıkarılan özsu oluşunu belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: acı ağaç özü ve bundan yapılan ilaç

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir ağaçtan çıkarılan acı özsuyu ve ilacı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir ağacın çok ekşi ve çekirdekli meyvesini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bitki kökenli, keskin tatlı bir maddeyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal işlenmiş özsu ve ilaçtır; komşu dal ise ağacın yenilebilir ya da kullanılan meyvesidir ve tadı acı değil belirgin biçimde ekşidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; acı özsu ile ekşi meyve arasındaki bitkisel gönderge ayrımı en yararlı karşılaştırmadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبر بكسر الباء: عصارة شجرة أو دواء مر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الصبار بمعنى التمر الهندي، ولا الصبر بمعنى الثبات.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصبر بكسر الباء عصارة شجرة (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الصبر هذا الدواء المر (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir ağacın çok ekşi, geniş kırmızı çekirdekli meyvesini tanımlar. Dal bitkiden çıkarılmış acı ilaç maddesinden, taş ve kapatma anlamlarından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli ağacın çok ekşi meyvesidir; acı özsu, taş ve tıkaç anlamları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca belirli ağacın ekşi meyve göndergesini verir.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir ağacın çok ekşi tatlı, geniş ve kırmızı çekirdekli meyvesidir.

facets.statement: Gönderge bir ağacın meyvesidir.
Meyve çok ekşidir ve geniş kırmızı çekirdekler taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli ağaç meyvesini çok ekşi tadı ve geniş kırmızı çekirdekleriyle tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli ağacın ekşi meyvesini Türkçede yerleşik ve doğal adıyla karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Meyvenin kimliğini ve bitkisel göndergeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yerleşik adın bilinmediği bağlamlarda meyvenin türünü ve baskın tat niteliğini açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaç meyvesi oluşunu ve çok ekşi tadı korur.
error_profile.loses: Geniş kırmızı çekirdek ayrıntısını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal çok ekşi ve çekirdekli bir ağaç meyvesini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir ağaçtan çıkarılan acı özsuyu ve bundan yapılan ilacı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bitki kökenli ve keskin tatlı bir maddeyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ağacın meyvesidir; komşu dal ise başka bir bitkisel gönderge olan işlenmiş özsu ve ilaçtır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; ekşi meyve ile acı bitki özü arasındaki ayrım anlam sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبار بضم الصاد، حمل شجرة حامض له عجم أحمر عريض يسمى التمر الهندي.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الصبر الدواء المر، ولا الصبار بمعنى الحجارة أو السداد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصبار حمل شجرة طعمه أشد حموضة من المصل (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الصبار التمر الهندي (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi beyaz bulutu, yoğun bulutun üzerinde düz duran bulut katmanını ve basamaklar gibi üst üste yığılan bulutları birlikte verir. Çekirdek bulutun beyazlığı ve katmanlı yığılmasıdır; genel yığın yapma eylemi bu dala ancak karşılaştırma düzeyinde yaklaşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal beyaz ve katmanlı buluta özgüdür; genel yığılma, yağmur adı ve başka nesne adları kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca beyaz, düz katmanlı veya üst üste yığılmış bulut anlamını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Yoğun bir bulut tabakasının üstünde düz duran ya da kat kat üst üste yığılan beyaz buluttur.

facets.statement: Gönderge beyaz bir buluttur.
Bulut yoğun bir tabakanın üstünde düz durur veya basamaklar gibi üst üste yığılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar beyaz bulutu, yoğun bulutun üstündeki düz katmanı ve birbirinin üstüne basamaklı biçimde yığılan bulutları aynı görünüm içinde tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Beyazlık ile düz ya da basamaklı üst üste yığılma özelliklerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut göndergesini, beyazlığı ve katmanlı yığılmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir düz tabakadan çok çoklu bulut katmanlarının görünümünün öne çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beyaz bulutların üst üste yığılmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yoğun bir tabakanın üstünde tek ve düz durma seçeneğini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal özellikle beyaz bulutun düz veya basamaklı katmanlarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bulut, kum, çamur ya da ordu dahil her tür nesnenin üst üste yığılma sürecini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda parçaların ya da tabakaların üst üste gelmesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir doğal nesnenin görünüşünü adlandırır; komşu dal ise nesne türüyle sınırlı olmayan genel bir toplama ve yığma sürecidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; buluta özgü katmanlı görünüm ile genel yığılma süreci arasındaki karşılaştırma yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبر أو الصبير للسحاب الأبيض أو السحاب المستوي فوق الكثيف، والسحاب الذي يصبر بعضه فوق بعض درجا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس صبير الخوان ولا صبير القوم ولا صبر النفس.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصبر سحاب مستو فوق السحاب الكثيف (ayn)؛ الصبير السحاب الأبيض (sihah;tahdhib)؛ السحاب الأبيض الذي يصبر بعضه فوق بعض درجا (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الاصبار السحائب البيض (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir nesne sınıfı değil, sofra altına serilen geniş ince parça ile üst üste konmuş yiyecek yığını ve ölçmeden yapılan alış biçimini yan yana verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bunları birleşik bir nesne gibi sunmamalı; ayrı sözlüksel yüzler olarak göstermelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnce sofra yaygısı, yiyecek yığını ve ölçüsüz toplu alım ayrı yüzlerdir; tek bir birleşik nesne sayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; sofra yaygısı ve yığın yüzleri, ölçmeden satın alma kalıbından açıkça ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Sözlüksel aile, yiyeceğin altına serilen geniş ince parçayı ve üst üste konmuş yiyecek yığınını ayrı ayrı adlandırır. Kalıba bağlı kullanım, malı tartmadan veya ölçmeden topluca satın almayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir kullanım, yiyeceğin altına serilen geniş ve ince parçayı belirtir.
Başka bir kullanım, yiyeceğin parçaları üst üste konularak oluşan yığını belirtir.
Satın alma kalıbında mal tartılmadan ve ölçülmeden toplu halde alınır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi sofra altında kullanılan geniş ince parçayı, üst üste konmuş yiyecek yığınını ve malın ölçülmeden topluca alınmasını ayrı kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: sofra yaygısı ya da yiyecek yığını
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın iki nesne yüzünü kısa biçimde ayırır; satın alma kalıbı bağlamsal karşılıkta ayrıca verilir.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş ince sofra parçası ile üst üste yiyecek yığını yüzlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Malı tartmadan veya ölçmeden topluca satın alma kalıbını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir malın tek tek tartılmadan veya hacmi ölçülmeden yığın halinde alındığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Satın alma işlemini ve ölçü ya da tartı kullanılmamasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sofra yaygısı ve yiyecek yığını nesne anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yiyeceğin altına serilen geniş ince yaygı
malı tartmadan ya da ölçmeden topluca aldım
düğün yemeğinin üstüne konduğu ince yaygı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yiyecek yığınını adlandırır ve ayrıca sofra yaygısı ile ölçüsüz alım yüzleri taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal farklı türde nesnelerin üst üste toplanması eylemini genel olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda nesnelerin üst üste gelerek bir yığın oluşturması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın yığın yüzü yiyeceğe ve ortaya çıkan toplu nesneye bağlıdır; komşu dal nesne türünden bağımsız bir yığma sürecidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yiyeceğe özgü yığın ile nesne türünden bağımsız yığma eylemi arasındaki ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه صبير الخوان الرقاقة العريضة تحت الطعام، والصبرة من الطعام إذا كان بعضه فوق بعض أو بيع بلا كيل ووزن.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الصبار النباتي ولا الحجارة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: صبير الخوان رقاقته العريضة تبسط تحت ما يؤكل من الطعام (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الصبرة من الطعام بعضه فوق بعض (ayn;tahdhib)؛ اشتريت الشيء صبرة أي بلا وزن ولا كيل (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi önceki bir öldürmeye karşılık aynı cezayı isteme ve yetkilinin suçluyu bu karşılıkla öldürmesi işlemlerini verir. Anlam, birini öldürülmek üzere yalnızca bağlı tutmaktan ayrılır; kurucu ilişki önceki suç ile ona denk verilen ölüm cezasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal önceki öldürmeye karşılık verilen ölüm cezasıdır; öldürme öncesi alıkoyma veya genel cezalandırma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım ödeşme amacı taşıyan öldürme işlemini korur ve alıkoyma kalıbını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir öldürmenin karşılığı olarak suçluya denk ölüm cezası istemek ya da yetkili makamın bu cezayı uygulayıp onu öldürmesidir.

facets.statement: Önceki bir öldürmeye karşılık denk bir ölüm cezası söz konusudur.
İşlem cezayı isteme veya yetkili makamın hükmü uygulayarak öldürmesi aşamalarını kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı ifade, önceki öldürmeye denk karşılık istemeyi ve yetkilinin suçluyu bu hükümle öldürmesini aynı ceza ilişkisi içinde verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Önceki öldürme ile ona denk cezanın istenmesi veya uygulanması ilişkisini eksiksiz açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki suçu, denk karşılığı ve ölüm cezası sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öldürülen kişi için suçluya denk ölüm cezası talep etme aşamasının öne çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Yetkilinin cezayı uygulayıp suçluyu öldürmesi aşamasını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yetkili onu önceki öldürmeye karşılık öldürdü

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaralama ve başka hak ihlallerinde de suçun denginin uygulanmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal suçluya işlediği eyleme denk bir karşılık uygulanmasını temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ölümle sonuçlanan suça ve ölüm cezasına bağlı dar bir uygulamadır; komşu dal aynı denklik ilkesini yaralama ve başka hak alanlarına genişletir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اصطبر بمعنى اقتص، وأصبره السلطان إذا أقصه أو قتله بقود.
